## Summary

Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

Only optional test corrections were found in the reviewed scope. The tests leave basename matching in subdirectories unprotected and tie the omitted flag to a specific parser representation.

## Changes

The pull request adds a repeatable `--exclude GLOB` option that matches file basenames and logs skipped files at INFO level. It also adds flag documentation, tests, and a review fixture.

## Suggestions

- cli/main.py:33 — tests — Cover basename matching in subdirectories — For `nested/debug.log` with `--exclude 'debug*.log'`, no test checks that the file is skipped. Every exclusion test uses a leading-wildcard glob that would also match a full path. — A regression that matches full paths could silently include nested files while all exclusion tests still pass.
- tests/test_main.py:24 — tests — Test archive behavior when `--exclude` is omitted — With `--exclude` omitted, this assertion would reject an empty tuple even though `collect` accepts it and archives the same files. — A change to the parser’s default container could fail the test while preserving the documented CLI behavior.
